query: SELECT m.channel_id, COALESCE(m.name, c.profile->>'display_name', c.profile->>'name', 'Agent') AS "title!" FROM channel_members m JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = m.channel_id JOIN conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.conversation_id = $1 AND ch.kind = 'channel' AND ch.state = 'open' AND m.role <> 'observer'
